Reading: one good drink a day when working normally; hard work needs a drink about every 26 game hours.

## Exertion and fitness

Walking is sustainable; running is not. From the design notes: an unfit (fitness 0) character jogging is winded in about 70 s and sprinting in about 35 s. Recovery is not changed by fitness.

| Fitness | Exertion rises at | Jog until winded | Sprint until winded |
|---|---|---|---|
| -10 | 165% of normal | 42 s | 21 s |
| -5 | 128% of normal | 55 s | 27 s |
| +0 | 100% of normal | 70 s | 35 s |
| +5 | 78% of normal | 90 s | 45 s |
| +10 | 61% of normal | 115 s | 58 s |

Thresholds: over-exerted at 1.00 (pace x0.9, running on allowed), faint at 1.40, recover below 0.75. Faint lasts 8 s, waking 12 s.

## Warmth

Cold starts to hurt health when the body's target warmth drops under 20, which on a still dry day is about -7 C (comfort 20 C, 3.0 warmth points per degree). Wind chill up to 6 C, rain or snow on you x1.5, swimming follows the water (see Swimming); a fire within 4 m is worth +20 C; cover cuts wind to 30%.

Warmth moves toward its target with a time constant of 3 game hours falling and 0.5 rising; health drains at most 0.30 per real second, never below 1.

## Sickness

Rotten food: sick 24 game hours (60 real minutes), exertion floor 50%, a symptom every 90 s, 4x faster asleep. Medicine takes off 18 hours.

## Skills

Skills run 1 to 100 and are trained in steps of 25 (an untrained skill stops at 25, each training level adds 25). Each success adds about 7.0 practice units x difficulty, with a 2 s cooldown per skill and a soft cap of 300 units a game day; a skill costs 40 units for its first point and 4.5% more for every point after. Idle skills decay after 7 game days, halving every 60 days, never under 20% of the best.

## Coins and shop prices

10 copper = 1 bronze, 10 bronze = 1 silver, 10 silver = 1 gold. A stranger pays 130% of an item's value and is paid 55% for it; reputation, charisma and luck move that toward at best x1.05 and 90% (never past). A trader tires of buying the same item: each unit sold lowers its price 3 points down to 30%, back 4 points a minute.

## Survival day, all vitals together

Warmth target in ordinary wind (0.4) on a dry day; the number in brackets is how many game hours until health starts to drain (target under 20), a dash if never. The weather gives a seasonal temperature; warmth adds a day and night swing on top (temperate 5 to 11 C by season, low at 6:30, high at 15:00, smaller in cloud, rain and wind), so dawn in autumn is about 4 C colder than these table values and the afternoon 5 C warmer.

| Where | naked | grass set (skirt, cloak, sandals) | hide set (cloak, boots, hood, mittens, leggings) |
|---|---|---|---|
| temperate summer 24 C | 100 (-) | 100 (-) | 100 (-) |
| temperate spring or autumn 10 C | 63 (-) | 71 (-) | 91 (-) |
| temperate winter -4 C | 21 (-) | 37 (-) | 80 (-) |
| arctic winter -23 C | 0 (4.8 h) | 0 (4.8 h) | 66 (-) |

Swimming (cold follows the water): 24 C air gives 20 C water and a warmth target of 72 naked; 10 C air gives 11 C water and a warmth target of 23 naked; -4 C air gives 1 C water and a warmth target of 0 naked. The body cools with a time constant of 0.7 game hours in water (2 real minutes), so a cold swim is dangerous within about an hour.

Cooking: a roast keeps 2.0 times what the raw item had left, up to its own shelf life; roast forage up to 24 game days, roast meat 8, raw meat 3. A hot meal adds 10 warmth points when eaten (roast forage), tea 12. Raw meat, fiddleheads and beans make you sick for 12 to 24 hours, acorns and wild mushrooms for 6.

A game day, put together: food lasts 24 game hours of walking, water 36, energy 3 game days awake, then sleep (see Energy); cold is the only vital that can hurt a well-fed, rested character, and only in winter or in water without clothes. Sickness (6 to 24 hours at exertion 0.5) costs food and water but never health beyond what hunger already allows.

## Fishing

A cast waits 6 to 22 s, then a bite lasts 3 s. Chance of a bite on a cast (fresh pond, novice, no bait): 55% base; dawn or dusk x1.3, midday x0.7, light rain x1.2, storm x0.4, cold water x0.6, bait x1.3, ice hole x0.5.

A cast takes about 17 s of waiting. At 72% that would be 151 bites an hour without any limit, so the hidden stock is what really paces fishing: a cell holds only 4 to 12 fish and gets one back per game day (one real hour), so a spot gives about 4 to 12 fish at first and then roughly one an hour, however good the player is.
Spear: 20% for a novice, at most 60%, depth 1.5 m or less, a jab every 1.2 s.
A trout feeds 220 kcal raw, 650 roasted (0.3 of a walking day's 2400 kcal).

## Skills web: hours of play to reach each value (design, not built)

From tools/skills_sim.py: practice cost of the next point = 40 x 1.045^(n-1) x 1.5 per generation, 300 practice units a game day (a real hour) at most, untrained cap 25, +25 per training level (a teacher is assumed found at each cap; training gains x1.2).
